subject: pe
title: Team Sports: Netball & Basketball
welcome_lead: Two fast hand-ball games — different rules, same buzz.
meta_desc: KS3 PE: netball and basketball basics, positions, key rules.
final_note: Quick passes and smart movement win both games.

concepts.def: Rules about steps when holding the ball.
Attempt to score in the goal/basket.
Turn keeping one foot on the spot.

walkthroughs.body_html: Netball has 7 players. You can't dribble or run with the ball — you must pass within 3 seconds. Positions limit where you can go on court.
Basketball has 5 a side. You dribble with one hand at a time. Score by getting the ball through the hoop.
Both games have footwork rules. In netball you can pivot on a landed foot. In basketball travelling (extra steps) is a foul.
